result.evidence_quote: Furthermore, TIM-3 was not only expressed by TILs but also by immunoregulatory macrophages, and may represent an important immune escape mechanism in ITACs, since TIM-3 blockade in patient-derived explants led to increased tumor cell apoptosis.
result.rationale: The study directly addresses cancer immune escape mechanisms, prognostic biomarkers, and experimental immunotherapy. It links immune-cell features to survival and demonstrates increased tumor cell apoptosis after TIM-3 blockade in patient-derived explants.
